_comment: Which requests invoke the Pages Function. Everything matched by `include`
runs functions/e/[slug].ts and is BILLED AS A WORKER REQUEST; everything
else is served as a static asset, which is free and unmetered.
Only the event page needs the Function (it injects per-event share tags).
Wrangler generates this file when it is absent, but the default is not
worth guessing at when the difference is every asset request on the site
turning into a paid invocation. Keep `include` as narrow as possible.
